messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT detected 1972-03-12 02:11 UTC — high error rate on /v1/generate (eu-west). 80% 5xx for 10m. Pager escalated to alex_g (oncall). Auto-failover attempted to 'eu-west-standby'.
alex_g (oncall): I'm on it. checking routing + model pool. seeing upstream GPU OOMs on pool-redwood-2, appears to be traffic spike from customer X.
alex_g (oncall): quick mitigation: enabling strict rate-limit for customer X to 20rps and routing non-critical customers to fallback model small-v1. Doing now.
ops-bot: Command executed: /route set-policy --pool pool-redwood-2 --limit 20 --project customer-x — success
alex_g (oncall): rate limit applied. errors dropped to ~25% now. Still monitoring.
maria_p (sre): taking over for Alex in 15m for stabilization + post-incident writeup. @alex_g can you drop the short summary for the postmortem?
alex_g (oncall): summary draft below — please edit as needed:
```
Root cause: sudden traffic spike from customer-x causing GPU OOMs in dedicated pool (pool-redwood-2). Auto-failover started; some requests retried and overloaded standby in same region. Mitigations: emergency rate-limit on offending customer, route non-critical requests to small-v1, temporarily increase autoscale headroom for pool-redwood-2. Impact: 10m of increased 5xx for ~18% of requests in eu-west, affecting ~120k tokens and 4 paying customers with degraded latency.
```
kevin_e (platform): tagging potential followups: (a) better per-project soft caps, (b) autoscale cooldown tuning, (c) KV cache warmup for standby. I'll create action tickets.
jess_f (finance): from Impact -> we'll need estimated customer downtime window and token counts to compute SLA credits. @maria_p can you post confirmed numbers when stabilized?
maria_p (sre): stabilized. Confirmed window 02:11–02:21 UTC. Total affected tokens ~118,900 (estimate from logs). Affected paying customers: customer-x (triggering), customer-y, customer-z, customer-q. Percent of requests failing for those tenants ranged 30-75 during the peak.
jess_f (finance): thanks. For billing we need: affected invoice periods, baseline usage for each customer, and proposed credit method (percent-of-usage vs flat). Recommend percent-of-usage for simplicity.
alex_g (oncall): proposal: credit 5% of billed usage for the invoice period for customers who saw >20% error rate, scaled to their affected token fraction.
kevin_e (platform): noted. I'll attach logs and the per-customer token split to the postmortem doc (link: https://redwood.internal/pm/1972009876).
maria_p (sre): scheduling postmortem 1972-03-13 10:00 UTC — invite sent to eng-sre, platform, finance, product. ACTION: create PM with timeline + raw query for tokens. Owner: kevin_e. Ticket: PLT-4227.
kevin_e (platform): created PLT-4227 and BILL-1892 (billing adj worksheet). Adding checklist: verify tokens, compute per-customer affected tokens, calculate credit amounts, prepare GL adjustment doc.
jess_f (finance): will review BILL-1892. Expected tasks on finance side: (1) confirm credit amounts, (2) prepare journal entries for next billing run, (3) notify customers and issue credits. ETA 3 business days.
alex_g (oncall): pair handoff: maria_p now oncall owner for incident writeup. I'm available for postmortem.
maria_p (sre): postmortem notes draft uploaded. Highlights: root cause, timeline, mitigation steps, followups (PLT-4227, INF-3310 for per-project soft caps, DOCS-88 update for runbook).
jess_f (finance): one more requirement: for customer contracts with SLA caps, legal wants the credit amounts logged with incident ID and signed approval. Assigning jess_f as approver owner for finance.
kevin_e (platform): tagging: @jess_f — added incident ID INC-1972009876 to BILL-1892. Please ack.
jess_f (finance): ack. I'll coordinate with accounting to post credits and provide customer-facing copy.
alex_g (oncall): quick followup: is there an open question about automatic refunds for usage above threshold? @kevin_e
kevin_e (platform): not yet. ACTION: evaluate automatic crediting flow (INF-3311) — if feasible we can reduce manual work.
maria_p (sre): closing notes: please update the incident playbook with explicit step to throttle by project and not only by pool. ACTION OWNER mapping: PLT-4227 -> kevin_e, INF-3310 -> maria_p, BILL-1892 -> jess_f, INF-3311 -> kevin_e.
ops-bot: Reminder created: follow-up meeting scheduled in 3 days; tasks due in 7 days.
jess_f (finance): I'll post confirmation here once GL adjustments applied and customers credited. Please tag me if any invoices require manual edits. :thumbsup:
